title: HackSpire'26
description: HackSpire'26 – The Flagship Hackathon of FIEM ACM Student Chapter. HackSpire is the flagship annual hackathon organized by the FIEM ACM Student Chapter, recognized as the Most Active ACM Student Chapter in East India. Following the tremendous success of our previous editions—including 4100+ registrations, 270 in-person participants, and 50+ innovative project submissions—we are excited to announce HackSpire'26, set to be bigger, bolder, and more impactful than ever before. HackSpire brings together some of the brightest student innovators, developers, and creators from across the country for an intense 26-hour hackathon experience filled with innovation, collaboration, and learning. Participants will work in teams to build solutions for real-world challenges while exploring cutting-edge technologies across multiple domains.
